review_status: Source-checked project summaries; veterinary review and clinical validation pending.

krebs_mastitis_2023.title: Krebs et al. (2023): Severity of Clinical Mastitis and Bacterial Shedding

lsd_signs.text: General reference context: LSD can involve skin nodules, fever, enlarged lymph nodes and oedema. These are described disease signs, not findings established in this animal by the classifier or mask.

lsd_production.text: General reference context: LSD can reduce milk production and affect animal welfare. Neither production loss nor systemic involvement has been measured by this image pipeline.

lsd_exam.text: If examination findings are available, review the distribution of skin lesions, temperature, lymph nodes and oedema with the veterinarian.

lsd_history.text: Review the reported course of the lesions and any change in milk production; neither is inferred from this crop.

fmd_confirmation.text: General reference context: clinical suspicion of FMD requires prompt laboratory confirmation because other vesicular diseases can resemble it. A classifier prediction does not confirm infection.

fmd_signs.text: General reference context: FMD can involve oral or foot vesicles, lameness, salivation and reduced appetite. These findings are not established merely by a disease label or foreground mask.

fmd_confirmation_check.text: Discuss prompt veterinary examination and appropriate confirmatory laboratory testing for suspected FMD, regardless of the visual-burden band.

fmd_exam.text: If findings are available, review oral and foot lesions, mobility, salivation and appetite with the veterinarian.

mastitis_hierarchy.text: General reference context: clinical mastitis grading distinguishes abnormal milk, additional local udder inflammation, and systemic illness. Crop-mask coverage does not establish that clinical hierarchy.

mastitis_local.text: If available, review milk appearance and local udder inflammation with the veterinarian; these findings are not supplied by a classifier probability.

mastitis_systemic.text: Review measured temperature and behaviour for systemic involvement when assessed. A small predicted mask does not exclude systemic illness.
